definitions.delta: exp16 - exp15; negative means lower error or token usage.
definitions.reduction_pct: 100 * (paired mean exp15 - paired mean exp16) / paired mean exp15; unavailable if baseline is zero.
definitions.state: Same sum-over-10 metrics as view_results; shared range/SD from 100 unique planned target states; roll/yaw use shortest-angle errors.
definitions.accuracy_denominator: Both experiments must have a valid full 10-step answer. Each response window has equal weight.
definitions.usage_denominator: Both usage values available, including parse failures.
definitions.end_to_end_action: Count steps with both a valid full response and all three correct movement IDs / all planned steps. This is a success rate, not state-error imputation.
definitions.interpretation: Descriptive paired results only; few dependent windows and a single recording. The empirical prior in 16 was fitted using the evaluated recording.
